checks.text: The page shows the heading "Travel Planner" and three tabs labelled "Calendar", "Budget" and "Packing".

On the Calendar tab, clicking the button "New event" opens a form; filling the field labelled "Title" with "Flight to Paris", the field labelled "Date" with "2025-06-15", the field labelled "Start time" with "08:30", and clicking "Save" adds a calendar event that displays "Flight to Paris" on the 15th of June.

On the Budget tab, filling the field labelled "Item" with "Hotel" and the field labelled "Amount" with "450.75" and clicking "Add item" adds a row showing "Hotel" and "$450.75"; the summary line shows "Total: $450.75".
On the Budget tab, after adding "Hotel" 450.75, adding a second item with "Item" "Flights" and "Amount" "800.25" shows a row "Flights" "$800.25" and the summary line "Total: $1,251.00".
On the Packing tab, typing "Passport" in the field labelled "New item" and pressing Enter adds a checkable item "Passport"; the progress indicator shows "0 of 1 packed".
On the Packing tab, after adding "Passport" and "Charger", clicking the checkbox next to "Passport" changes the progress indicator to "1 of 2 packed".
On the Budget tab, clicking the button "Delete Hotel" removes the Hotel row and the summary line shows "Total: $800.25".
On the Calendar tab, clicking the button "Export ICS" copies an ICS string to the clipboard that contains "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "Flight to Paris".
Reload keeps the event "Flight to Paris" on the Calendar tab, the budget item "Flights" with "$800.25" on the Budget tab, and the packing item "Passport" checked on the Packing tab.
